description: Publishes a privacy-minimized selected-field snapshot of the City of Los Angeles Office of Finance monthly active-business listing and provisional registered-location/establishment records without inferring ownership or continuous operations.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact data.lacity.org metadata and 6rrh-rzua JSON resource paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, source refresh drift, count mismatch, duplicate location-account identity, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: The selected-field source snapshot is acquired in deterministic location-account and Socrata-row order and hashed before normalization. Source metadata and total rows are rechecked before publication. A complete unpublished staging run can be verified and resumed by immutable run ID without reacquisition. current.json changes only after complete run-scoped publication.
idempotency: The catalog rowsUpdatedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the ordered selected-field source artifact identify a source release; the Office of Finance location account creates stable provisional site and establishment candidates.
cancellation: Abort network requests and local record processing cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and local-review-only normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
